# Hole-union fixture. The same file in js-sdk-core, android-sdk-core and ios-sdk-core.
#
# unionHoleRings must keep the area of the union of the holes: holes that touch
# at a point or share an edge (or part of one) add up, an overlap counts once.
# unionArea is shapely's unary_union of the holes.
#
#   case|name|unit|originLongitude|originLatitude|unionArea
#   outer|x,y,x,y,...     (optional: the polygon's outline)
#   hole|x,y,x,y,...      (one line per hole, not closed)
#
# A vertex is (originLongitude + x * unit, originLatitude + y * unit) degrees,
# and areas are in unit². The Boston street parcels are Analyze Boston's
# Parcels 2025 (ODC PDDL) rounded to 1e-5 degree, before their holes were
# moved apart (examples/basic/tools/boston/pack.py in react-sdk).
